data.body: OPERATOR RULING (2026-08-21, via orchestrator session d958f0b2): The F01 character-restriction policy (banning U+003B and U+2014 in ticket writing) is an OVERREACH — it implements a character restriction that was previously REJECTED, precisely because the fragility introduced by enforcing character restrictions in documentation outweighs any benefit of restricting. Consequence for this ticket: the proposed multiline provenance grammar + ADR 0061 amendment is NOT the sanctioned direction. The conflict resolves the other way: remove/withdraw the F01 character restriction; the provenance close-guard grammar (which requires those code points) stands unchanged. This lane belongs to the documentation-infra session — leaving the ticket open for that session to action the withdrawal against F01.
